name: Mer-Ek
description: The stone citadel that is the seat of the Abzan khan.

timeline.summary: Daghatar convenes twenty Abzan advisors at Mer-Ek, and Reyhan and Merel argue between striking at Dromoka and enduring.
timeline.quote: We bring down Dromoka, and her brood will scatter.

timeline.summary: Merel warns that the first battle against Dromoka cost over a thousand soldiers with no damage to her, and Daghatar acknowledges the Abzan may be facing the end.
timeline.quote: we may be facing the end of the Abzan.

timeline.summary: Daghatar consults the Remembrance, which urges him to do what must be done and recalls his first crisis, when a patrol was captured by the Sultai.
timeline.quote: To suffer a defeat and yet lose none of your strength.

pages_say.description: The stone citadel that is the seat of the Abzan khan.
